candidate.gold_action: Choose the shorefront first-floor walkout room and avoid the repeated beach drive.
candidate.label_rationale: The balcony should influence a scenic family stay, but Danielle has explicitly kept it subordinate to overall property suitability and accepts first-floor outdoor access. Her earlier coastal reasoning also treated reduced beach driving as independently important, so direct shore access outweighs B's balcony and $25 saving.
